items.title: Modine Promotes Art Laszlo to President of Newly Created Data Centers Segment
items.summary: Modine (NYSE: MOD), a diversified global leader in thermal management technology and solutions, has announced the promotion of Art Laszlo to President, Data Centers, effective April 1. Mr. Laszlo will lead the newly created Data Centers segment, which was formerly part of the Climate Solutions segment. Eric McGinnis will continue to lead the remainder of the Climate Solutions segment until his previously announced planned retirement. The company will report these two segments with first quarter fiscal 2027 results. The Performance Technologies segment also will continue to be reported as a separate segment until its spin-off later this calendar year as part of the previously announced transaction with Gentherm. Mr. Laszlo is responsible for driving growth and profitability in Modine's highly strategic Data Centers business, further strengthening its position as a leading provider of innovative cooling solutions to the world's leading data center operators.
